title: Outreach Ops — Cold Email Infrastructure Monitoring & Automation Platform
shortTitle: Outreach Ops — Cold Email Infrastructure Monitoring & Automation Platform
headline: Outreach Ops: Smart Outreach, Simplified.
description: Outreach Ops is a centralized outreach management platform designed to simplify email outreach, manage domains, monitor email deliverability, and automate daily operations. It helps teams organize outreach activities, track performance, manage sending domains, and streamline workflows through a clean dashboard. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase, Outreach Ops brings essential outreach tools together in one place, reducing manual work and improving operational efficiency.
deliverables: Outreach activity tracking and performance insights
Automated email notifications and scheduled tasks
Responsive dashboard UI with Tailwind CSS
Automated workflows to reduce manual operations
Secure authentication and server side operations
